title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - PublicAdministration
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/PublicAdministration. Public leadership of public affairs directly responsible for executive action (definition taken from Wikidata, https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q31728). Subclass of org:Organization (http://www.w3.org/ns/org#Organization) per the SAREF4CITY ontology, with no properties of its own. Note that org:Organization is not itself a subclass of s4city:Agent (it is a sibling branch under foaf:Agent), so a PublicAdministration instance does not automatically carry the cpsv:provides / cpsv:uses relationships; per the normative ETSI TS 103 410-4 worked example, instances that need to provide or use PublicService entities are additionally typed as s4city:Agent (see the Agent model) in the same way a single real-world entity (e.g. a city council) is simultaneously an Organization and an Agent.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PublicAdministration'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
